machine: Apple M2, 8 GiB RAM, macOS, native headed Chromium
notes: No GPU timer queries in presentation FPS runs.
CPU timers are nested; do not add them together. _drawLayersMs is draw submission, not total CPU.
submittedVertices counts submitted indices for indexed draws, not unique vertex shader executions.
bufferBytes can include uniform buffers uploaded via COPY_WRITE_BUFFER.
GPU Memory is Luma tracked allocation; heapBytes is Chromium estimated JS heap.
Timing runs used animated wind; fixed wind captures are controls only.
Two short repetitions on a working desktop show observed variation, not an isolated-device guarantee.
